sections.principal_risks: Principal risks and uncertainties The process of risk acceptance and risk management is addressed through a framework of policies , procedures and internal controls. All policies are subject to Board approval and ongoing review by management. Compliance with regulation , legal and ethical standards is a high priority for the company. The main risk to the company is competitive pricing in the wholesale food industry , the company mitigates this risk by stocking products of a high quality. The company also maintains strong relationships with key contacts within the purchasing supply chain. UK economic growth remains unclear and future prospects maybe influenced by developments outside of the UK. Key performance indicators The results for the company for the year were considered to be satisfactory by the directors. Turnover has increased 10.7% in the year and the gross profit % achieved in 2025 remained consistent with the prior year.An increase in overheads , mainly relating to salary costs resulted in a reduction of net profit compared to the prior year. The directors view the results to be satisfactory with similar results expected for 2026. Other performance indicators The directors consider turnover , gross profit margin (GPM) and cash flow to be the primary KPI's. Turnover increased in the year by 10.7%. GPM achieved for 2025 is12.15% compared to 12.27% for the prior year. Cashflow reduced in the year , this is explained by a reduction in certain suppliers credit days. On behalf of the board Mr A Salahshouri Director 5 January 2026 DLS (NE) HOLDINGS LIMITED
